beige_vs_white_downsample_emont_prog

Sarah Hazell Pickering

2025-08-26

Using Azimuth to transfer cell identities found in emont et al 2022 to the beige and white timecourse.

library(Azimuth)
library(SeuratData)
library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
module="adipogenesis"
qdataname = "beige_vs_white_downsample"
library(here); i_am(file.path("analysis", module,paste0(qdataname,"_emont_prog.Rmd")))
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/upr_in_adipo
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/upr_in_adipo
indir = here("output", module,qdataname)
odir = here(indir,"emont")
if (!dir.exists(odir)){dir.create(odir, recursive = T)}

subset_data =  F
load_data = T #Load prebuilt Azimuth reference
pal = c("#1F78B4", "#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
clusters = tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"))
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.25)))
figpath = here(odir,"plots")
if (!dir.exists(figpath)){dir.create(figpath, recursive = T)}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev=c('png','pdf'), fig.path=figpath)

Load Query Datasets

if (subset_data){
  qso = readRDS(here(indir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
  k.weight=5
} else {
  qso = readRDS(here(indir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  k.weight=50
}
qso
## An object of class Seurat 
## 36601 features across 44693 samples within 1 assay 
## Active assay: RNA (36601 features, 2000 variable features)
##  3 layers present: scale.data, data, counts
##  3 dimensional reductions calculated: pca, umap, tsne
DimPlot(qso, group.by = "seurat_clusters", shuffle = T) + scale_colour_manual(values = clusters)

DimPlot(qso, group.by = "cond.time", shuffle = T) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal)

Map clusters

Not many anchors found for mapping :/ so we’re adding a kweight limit to the Run Azimuth code aka. trace(“RunAzimuth.Seurat”, where=asNamespace(“Azimuth”), edit=T) adding kanchors=k.weight as a param to MappingScore on ln 107

annot <- RunAzimuth(
    query = qso,
    reference = "adiposeref",
    k.weight=k.weight)

colnames(annot@meta.data)
##  [1] "orig.ident"                  "nCount_RNA"                 
##  [3] "nFeature_RNA"                "sample"                     
##  [5] "condition"                   "time"                       
##  [7] "rep"                         "percent.mt"                 
##  [9] "RNA_snn_res.0.5"             "seurat_clusters"            
## [11] "cond.time"                   "time.rep"                   
## [13] "predicted.celltype.l1.score" "predicted.celltype.l1"      
## [15] "predicted.celltype.l2.score" "predicted.celltype.l2"      
## [17] "mapping.score"
table(annot$predicted.celltype.l2)
## 
##   hAd2 hASPC1 hASPC2 
##    578  16868  27247
summary(annot$predicted.celltype.l2.score)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##  0.2114  0.5815  0.7120  0.6963  0.8258  0.9844
DimPlot(annot, group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", shuffle = T) 

FeaturePlot(annot,"predicted.celltype.l2.score") + scale_colour_gradientn(colours =  spectral)
## Scale for colour is already present.
## Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.

annot$filt.emont.celltype = "uncertain"
annot$filt.emont.celltype[annot$predicted.celltype.l2.score > 0.75] =  
  annot$predicted.celltype.l2[annot$predicted.celltype.l2.score > 0.75]

DimPlot(annot, group.by = "filt.emont.celltype", shuffle = T) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00A087", "#E64B35","grey"))

VlnPlot(annot,"predicted.celltype.l2.score", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", pt.size = 0)

if (subset_data == FALSE){
  saveRDS(annot, file = here(odir, "complete_analysis.annot.rds"))
  sub = subset(annot, downsample=1000)
  saveRDS(sub,here(odir,"10%_complete_analysis.annot.rds"))
} else if (subset_data){ #if subset, don't save complete analysis
  saveRDS(annot,here(odir, "10%_subset_analysis.annot.rds"))
}
